title: Chapter 241 Guards Attack The City
content:
Chapter 241 Guards Attack The City

Suddenly hearing a noise outside the city wall, Wang Shuo secretly said: "Oops."

Because I forgot to call the craftsmen who were building the city wall back to the village.

Wang Shuo came to the city gate and took a look. Sure enough, Ni Wu had captured the craftsman from Wana Village.

"Ni Wu, let my people go!" Wang Shuo stood on the city wall and said loudly.

"You can let them go if you want, 1,000 gold coins per person." Ni Wu rode a tall horse, with 100 level 60 guards standing behind him. In addition, there were thousands of Iron Sword sect members.

One thousand gold coins per person, almost 10,000 energy crystals. Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to save the person first.

There is a great possibility of a war happening later. If one of his craftsmen is accidentally injured and the city wall is not built well, that will be the biggest trouble.

As for whether Ni Wu's attack could be repelled, Wang Shuo was not worried at all.

"You keep your word."

"Are you doubting my credibility?" Ni Wu snorted coldly.

Wang Shuo handed 10,000 energy crystals to Baili Liang and asked him to go out of the city to exchange hostages.

Perhaps Ni Wu didn't take Wang Shuo seriously either, and the hostage exchange went very smoothly.

In order to prevent the hostages from entering the city, Ni Wu took the opportunity to attack the city.

Wang Shuo specially asked everyone to enter the city from the north gate at the back.

Wait until Baili Liang leaves with the hostages.

Ni Wu said: "Wang Shuo, I won't talk nonsense to you. Today I asked you to join Nanshan Ji on the orders of the mayor."

"Aren't you here to collect taxes?" Wang Shuo frowned and asked doubtfully.

"Hmph, how could the mayor leave a power like yours alone? You have only two options now. If you don't surrender, I will have to eradicate you."

Wang Shuo glanced at the people in the city, then looked back at his subordinates to compare their strengths.

Could it be that this guy hasn’t done any research? Do you still think that you are something that can be manipulated by others?

Then he smiled slightly and said: "Ni Wu, fortunately you are from outside the territory, but you are willing to be the mayor's lackey."

Hearing this, Ni Wufeng was about to explode with anger. Ever since he was a child, no one had ever dared to speak to him like this.

"You are looking for death. There is only one way you can go now."

Ni Wu's eyes flashed fiercely and he ordered his men: "Attack."

Wang Shuo was just trying to see how they planned to attack.

100 Guards gave the answer.

They immediately took out many wooden engineering equipment parts, and after simple assembly, a movable ladder about 15 meters high was formed.

Ladder?

Let me go, they also have such engineering equipment, which Wang Shuo did not expect.

But fortunately there are only 2 of them, otherwise it would be really difficult to deal with.

Seeing the ladder slowly approaching the city wall, Wang Shuo stopped being polite and decisively asked the archers to release arrows.

Twenty bronze ballistas on the city wall also fired spears one after another.

The level of the guards is as high as level 60. The attacks of ordinary soldiers in Wana Village cannot break through the defense at all, and only heavy weapons can cause damage to them.

Seeing the ladder getting closer and closer, Wang Shuo was worried. If these 100 guards climbed onto the city wall, it would be really dangerous.

Even for Wang Shuo, it would be difficult to fight against a single guard.

"Quickly, attack their ladders to prevent them from approaching." Ayub shouted.

Since the tiger talisman was in Ayub's hands, Wang Shuo had no intention of returning it.

After all, it was Ayub who led everyone in training and cooperated with each other. The collaboration efficiency must be better than Wang Shuo.

Li Jianguo also quickly organized manpower and placed two catapults in the city.

It's just that the ladder is too close to the city wall, so it's not easy to aim.

Soon, the ladder was still leaning against the city wall, and a large number of guards rushed up the city wall with spears and arrows.
